title: European title races crystallise after one weekend — Manchester City five-from-five, Barcelona pulling away, Milan and Juventus back on track
summary: Three of Europe's biggest title races sharpened on a single weekend. In England, Manchester City's 5-3 win over Sunderland, completed by Erling Haaland's late fifth to silence Brian Brobbey's hat-trick for the promoted visitors, took Pep Guardiola's side five wins from five and three points clear of Arsenal after Brighton's 3-0 win at the Amex. In Spain, Raphinha's hat-trick at Sevilla and Atletico Madrid's 2-1 win over 10-man Real Madrid in the capital derby have left Barcelona six points clear of Madrid and five ahead of Atletico with a game in hand. In Italy, AC Milan's 3-0 win over Lecce.
